verdict.rationale: vLLM is an inference server, and an event-subscription webhook mechanism (for example, callbacks when requests or batches complete) is a fair question for that kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. Streaming outputs and the OpenAI-compatible API are client-pull and request/response features, not webhooks, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
